description: Checks that glide.knowman.section.view_roles.draft is not set to overly permissive roles such as itil, snc_internal, employee, or left empty. This property controls which roles can see articles in Draft state. If set to a common role, draft articles containing incomplete or sensitive information become visible to a broad audience before editorial review and approval.
name: cstaces-11e prop-draft-view-roles
resolution_details: Set glide.knowman.section.view_roles.draft to restrictive roles such as knowledge or knowledge_admin. Review any custom workflow states and ensure their corresponding view_roles properties are also restricted.
short_description: glide.knowman.section.view_roles.draft should be restricted to knowledge managem
